column2: [intro]
A salesman told me to buy this car,
Even though it's broken, I believed it at the start.
I wanted to impress my lovely neighbor Marie,
But she said, "Oh dear, you’ve been deceived by me."
I'm easily convinced,
Always ready to believe what they hint,
I’m like a sponge, I’m hooked,
All these tales make me dizzy and booked.
A guru told me to follow his creed,
That paying for his sessions would fulfill my need.
But I realized I was wasting my time,
So I ran away, escaping the climb.
I’m easily convinced,
I fall for every trap that’s been pinched,
But deep down, I don’t want to defend,
For it makes me laugh, makes my life transcend.
[ solo ]
I’m easily convinced,
I listen to others without much thought for me,
I live my life like a student eternally,
Always ready to learn, even from my misdeeds.
[outro]
